== Description ==
This template is used as a utility for making usage of [[w:c:dev:DiscordIntegrator|DiscordIntegrator]] easier. In order to integrate the widget, it first needs to be enabled, for instructions on how to do that check "''[[w:c:dev:DiscordIntegrator#Enabling_the_widget|Enabling the widget]]''" section in the documentation.

== Parameters ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width: 100%; text-align: center"
!Option
!Type
!What it changes
!Default
|-
!<code>id</code>
|String
|ID of the server. For more information on how to find Discord server ID, see "Enabling the widget" section in the documentation
'''This parameter is required for the widget to work'''
|N/A
|-
!<code>loggedIn</code>
|Boolean
|If set to true, widget will only work for logged in users
|N/A
|-
!<code>theme</code>
|String
|Theme of the widget. Can be set to either <code>light</code> or <code>dark</code>. If invalid option specified the default is used
|<code>dark</code>
|-
!<code>width</code>
|String
|Width of the widget.
|<code>100%</code>
|-
!<code>height</code>
|String
|Height of the widget.
|<code>90%</code>
|-
!<code>usePTB</code>
|Anything
|If to use the widget from Public Test Build server instead of the normal one
|N/A
|}
